theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 6 群

items.colloc: refuse an offer 拒絕提議 | refuse to comment 不予置評
items.distinct: decline 婉拒（較委婉）| reject 駁回（較強硬）
ex: The manager decided to refuse the new proposal.
經理決定拒絕這項新提案。
She refused to comment on the company merger.
她拒絕針對公司合併發表評論。
Please do not refuse the invitation to the gala.
請不要拒絕參加這次的盛會邀請。

items.colloc: remind someone of something 提醒某人某事 | remind someone to do something 提醒某人做某事
items.distinct: recall 回憶起 | remember 記得
ex: May I remind you about our meeting tomorrow?
我可以提醒你明天開會的事嗎？
The assistant reminded the CEO to sign the contract.
助理提醒執行長簽署合約。
This report reminds me of the previous market analysis.
這份報告讓我想到之前的市場分析。

items.pos: v. 修理 | n. 修繕
items.colloc: under repair 維修中 | repair the damage 修復損壞
items.distinct: fix 修復（口語）| mend 修補（衣物等）
ex: The company will repair the broken equipment immediately.
公司將會立即修理損壞的設備。
The office building is currently under major repair.
辦公大樓目前正在進行大規模修繕。
We need to repair the server before the deadline.
我們必須在截止日前修好伺服器。

items.colloc: reserve a table 訂位 | reserve the right 保留權利
items.distinct: book 預訂（飯店、機位）| preserve 保存
ex: I would like to reserve a table for four.
我想預訂一張四人的桌位。
The firm reserves the right to change the terms.
公司保留更改條款的權利。
They reserved the conference room for the presentation.
他們預訂了會議室進行簡報。

items.pos: n. 樣本 | v. 取樣
items.colloc: free sample 免費樣品 | product sample 產品樣本
items.distinct: example 例子 | specimen 標本
ex: The client requested a sample of the new fabric.
客戶要求提供新布料的樣品。
We analyzed the sample to ensure high quality standards.
我們分析了樣本以確保高品質標準。
Please send a product sample to our office today.
請今天寄送產品樣品到我們的辦公室。

items.pos: v. 分開 | adj. 分開的
items.colloc: separate account 分開的帳戶 | keep separate 分開存放
items.distinct: divide 分割 | detach 拆下
ex: The accounting department will separate personal and business expenses.
會計部門會將個人與公司開銷分開。
Please keep the invoices in a separate folder.
請將發票分開存放在不同的資料夾。
We need to separate the tasks into different categories.
我們需要將工作分開歸類到不同項目。

items.colloc: simple process 簡單的流程 | keep it simple 保持簡單
items.distinct: easy 容易的 | basic 基礎的
ex: The new software offers a very simple interface.
這套新軟體提供了非常簡單的介面。
We need a simple solution for this complex problem.
我們需要針對這個複雜問題提出簡單的解決方案。
The procedure for claiming refunds is quite simple.
申請退款的程序相當簡單。

items.pos: adj. 特定的 | 明確的
items.colloc: specific instructions 明確的指示 | specific time 特定時間
items.distinct: special 特別的 | concrete 具體的
ex: The client has specific requirements for the project.
客戶對這個專案有明確的要求。
Could you provide specific examples of your experience?
你能提供你經驗的具體例子嗎？
We need to meet at a specific time tomorrow.
我們明天需要在一個特定的時間碰面。

items.pos: n. 地點 | v. 發現
items.colloc: on the spot 當場 | parking spot 停車位
items.distinct: location 地點 | site 場所
ex: This is an ideal spot for a new office.
這是開設新辦公室的理想地點。
The auditor spotted an error in the financial report.
稽核員發現財務報告中的一個錯誤。
You must pay the fine on the spot.
你必須當場繳納罰款。

items.pos: n. 陳述；聲明 | 帳單
items.colloc: financial statement 財務報表 | make a statement 發布聲明
items.distinct: claim 主張 | account 帳戶
ex: The CEO released a statement regarding the layoff.
執行長發布了關於裁員的聲明。
Please check your monthly bank statement carefully.
請仔細檢查你的每月銀行對帳單。
She made a clear statement about the company policy.
她對公司政策做出明確的說明。

items.colloc: step by step 一步步地 | take steps 採取措施
items.distinct: stage 階段 | procedure 程序
ex: The first step is to register on our website.
第一步是在我們的網站註冊。
Management will take steps to improve employee morale.
管理層將採取措施改善員工士氣。
Follow these simple steps to install the printer.
按照這些簡單的步驟來安裝印表機。

items.colloc: make a suggestion 提出建議 | follow a suggestion 採納建議
items.distinct: advice 忠告 | proposal 提案
ex: Do you have any suggestions for our marketing plan?
你對我們的行銷計畫有什麼建議嗎？
The board accepted his suggestion for cost reduction.
董事會接受了他削減成本的建議。
I appreciate your helpful suggestion regarding the project.
我很感謝你對該專案提供的實用建議。

items.pos: adv. 絕對地 | 完全地
items.colloc: absolutely necessary 絕對必要 | absolutely right 完全正確
items.distinct: completely 完全地 | definitely 肯定地
ex: It is absolutely necessary to finish the report today.
今天完成報告是絕對必要的。
The new system works absolutely perfectly.
這套新系統運作得非常完美。
He is absolutely confident about winning the contract.
他對於拿下合約感到絕對有信心。

items.colloc: actually happen 實際上發生 | in fact 事實上
items.distinct: really 真地 | currently 目前
ex: The project was actually easier than we expected.
這個專案實際上比我們預期的簡單。
I actually spoke to the manager this morning.
我今天早上真的有跟經理談過話。
They are actually planning to open a new branch.
他們實際上正計畫開設一家新分店。

items.colloc: allow someone to do something 允許某人做某事 | be allowed to 被允許
items.distinct: permit 許可（正式）| let 讓（口語）
ex: The company policy does not allow working from home.
公司政策不允許在家工作。
This new software will allow us to save time.
這套新軟體將能讓我們節省時間。
Visitors are not allowed in the production area.
訪客不被允許進入生產區域。

items.colloc: tenth anniversary 十週年紀念 | celebrate the anniversary 慶祝週年
items.distinct: birthday 生日 | annual 年度
ex: We are celebrating our company's twentieth anniversary.
我們正在慶祝公司成立二十週年。
The firm will host a party for the anniversary.
公司將會為週年慶舉辦一場派對。
The event marks the fifth anniversary of the partnership.
這項活動標誌著合作關係的五週年。

items.pos: v. 吸引 | 呼籲 | n. 吸引力
items.colloc: appeal to someone 吸引某人 | appeal against a decision 對決定上訴
items.distinct: attract 吸引（物理）| plead 懇求
ex: The new product design appeals to young consumers.
這款新產品設計很吸引年輕消費者。
The union appealed for better working conditions.
工會呼籲改善工作條件。
He decided to appeal the court's recent decision.
他決定針對法院最近的判決進行上訴。

items.colloc: assist with something 協助處理某事 | assist someone in doing 協助某人做
items.distinct: help 幫助（通用）| support 支援
ex: Could you assist me with this software installation?
你能協助我處理這套軟體安裝嗎？
The team will assist the manager with the audit.
團隊將會協助經理進行審計。
We are looking for someone to assist our sales staff.
我們正在尋找協助銷售人員的人選。

items.pos: v. 假定 | 承擔（責任）
items.colloc: assume responsibility 承擔責任 | assume that 假定...
items.distinct: presume 推測 | take on 擔負
ex: Do not assume that the deal is already finalized.
別假定交易已經拍板定案了。
She will assume the role of director next month.
她下個月將會擔當總監的角色。
We assume that the shipment will arrive by Friday.
我們假定這批貨會在星期五前抵達。

items.colloc: pay attention to 注意 | draw attention to 引起關注
items.distinct: focus 焦點 | care 照顧
ex: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions.
請密切注意安全須知。
The new policy has drawn much attention from investors.
這項新政策引起了投資人的高度關注。
Thank you for your attention to this important matter.
感謝您對此重要事務的關注。
